title: app/scheduledJobs
description: Entry points definitions. As of v10.1.

additionalProperties.description: An entry point name. Should start with a lower case letter.

className.description: An entry point implementation. Should implement Espo\Core\EntryPoint\EntryPoint.

notExposed.description: If true, the entry point is not available via the regular entryPoint request – can be called only programmatically.

noAuth.description: If true, authentication is not required.
